title: Sport management
description: Manage Football, Basketball, Tennis, Baseball and Esports data categories. Enabling a sport does not connect a supplier.
placeholder: Search code, Chinese or English name
codeHint: Start with a lowercase letter; use lowercase letters, digits or underscores. Maximum 32 characters.
codeLocked: The code is reserved or referenced and cannot be changed.
sortHint: Selectors use ascending sort order. This list shows the newest sports first.
adaptationHint: Creating or enabling a sport does not connect a supplier or start collection. Other sports still need adapters and match modules.

prompts.delete: Delete this sport? Referenced or reserved sports cannot be deleted.
prompts.disable: Disable this sport? Existing checks restrict new configurations and relevant collection. History is retained; supplier statuses and queued tasks are not automatically changed.
prompts.enable: Enable this sport? This will not automatically start collection.

validation.code: Code must start with a lowercase letter and contain lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
validation.sort: Sort order must be an integer from 0 to 100000.

messages.loadFailed: Unable to load. Click Refresh to retry.
messages.saveFailed: Unable to save. Check the input or retry later.
messages.codeProtected: The sport code is referenced or reserved and cannot be changed.
messages.deleteProtected: This sport is referenced or reserved and cannot be deleted.
messages.conflict: The code is duplicated or the sport is referenced. Refresh and retry.
